title: Berek finds Isildur
description: Isildur's horse returns to the ash-lands and finds his master alive, cocooned in a cave of giant spiders. Together they fight free of the brood and its mother.

title: Estrid
description: On the road Isildur helps a wounded woman, Estrid, who hides Adar's brand on her neck. Wild Men ambush them and steal the horse; the Elf Arondir drives the raiders off.

title: Pelargir
description: The survivors of the Southlands shelter in the old Númenórean colony of Pelargir, where Bronwyn has died of her wound. Theo, raw with grief, pushes Arondir away — and slips out with Isildur by night to steal back the horse.

title: Taken in the night
description: At the Wild Men's camp something huge moves among the trees. Theo and the raiders are snatched away.

title: The Eagle and the sceptre
description: At Míriel's coronation Eärien denounces her before the court, holding up the palantír. Then a Great Eagle lands on the balcony — and Pharazôn steps out to meet it. The crowd takes it for a sign and shouts his name.

title: The Dwarves come to Eregion
description: Celebrimbor invites Prince Durin and Disa to Eregion and offers rings of power to save their darkening kingdom, in return for mithril. Durin distrusts the smooth stranger at the smith's shoulder. His father does not.

title: Adar's host sets out
description: Adar has made up his mind: every Orc in Mordor will march on Eregion to destroy Sauron. Not all of his children want another war.
